answer: Beacon spot-checks with heartbeats block fake identities. Each agent holds one heartbeat key and must answer a beacon challenge in 10 minutes; a wharf agent must show its log, and a missed check freezes its slot. Inspectors sample 5% hourly, so a tundra copy needs a live heartbeat. Faking 1000 identities costs 1000 x 40, or 40,000 units a day, above the diluted reward. An honest agent pays 40 and keeps its reward, passing at the zenith of demand.
